links.comparator_used: Nested model tiers: M1 clinical baseline features alone versus M2 (adding laboratory feature trajectories) and M3 (adding 20 polygenic risk scores); race-blind and race-aware specifications
links.outcome: Incremental discrimination (AUROC) from adding polygenic risk scores to the clinical and laboratory features, by cohort and self-reported race stratum
links.effect: PRS gain significant only in the BioMe Hispanic stratum (ΔAUROC +0.042; P = 0.003), with no significant within-stratum gain in five other cohort-by-race combinations. The full M3 model reached AUROC 0.813 in the AoU test set and 0.745 in BioMe.
links.quote: PRS contribution was significant only in the Bio  Me Hispanic (ΔAUROC + 0.042;  P = 0.003), with no significant within-stratum gain in five other cohort-by-race combinations.
